summary: Exclude inherited feature history from worktree contention

delivery.outcome: Remove false worktree contention from shared feature history while preserving actual dirty/committed conflicts and conservative fallback.
nonGoals: Change allocation policy or add a permanent gate bypass
Implement Planfile registration or change protected publication authority

architecture.decision: Intersect contributions against the shared origin default with successfully observed pair-relative contributions; retain dirty paths, rename fallback and unreadable-history conservatism.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded correction through protected delivery without deleting worktrees or weakening ownership checks.

validation.evidence: Shared committed feature history is not a competing writer; behavior is symmetric.
Dirty/committed competition, rename conflicts, incomplete Git reads and pending-main imports remain protected.
